sections.title: Sound of the letter ka
paragraphs: The letter is called (ka) /ka/. It makes one main sound. You hear it in (kilo) /ki.lo/, which means a unit of weight. This letter has only one sound in the language.

sections.title: How to say it
paragraphs: Lift the back of your tongue against the soft roof of your mouth. Block the air flow completely. Drop your tongue quickly so the trapped air bursts out cleanly. Keep your vocal cords still. Place a hand on your throat to feel that your voice is silent and does not vibrate.

sections.title: Reading the letter
paragraphs: This letter always keeps its one sound in every position. You hear it at the start of (kilo) /ki.lo/. You also hear it at the end of (anorak) /a.nɔ.ʁak/.

sections.title: Common mistakes to avoid
paragraphs: Do not release a puff of breath after this sound. In English, the consonant in kite is aspirated, which means it has a puff of air. The French sound is never aspirated. Hold your hand in front of your lips and feel no burst of wind.
